'''2007 Endor Regionals Jordan Gosiaco DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jordan Gosiaco]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
